A Fire spell or a Fire attack heals him, so keep it out of the plan, and Gravity does nothing to him. On most turns he swings, with a Strength of 82, or casts Firaga on the whole party. Defense is the wall here, 98 of it, so Darkness, which ignores Defense and is no element, does the damage, and Armor Break helps the blades. He keeps a hidden count. Every action of his raises it by seven and every blow he takes by five. Each time it passes thirty, sixty and ninety, he sends a Meteor Strike at the girl who stands farthest from him. At a hundred he casts Hellfire on all three, and the count starts over. Firaga, Meteor Strike and Hellfire are all magic, so Shell halves every one of them. Heal the girl he is aiming at after each Meteor, and have everyone topped up before the Hellfire. The Meteors and Hellfire do not raise the count themselves, but every blow you land does, so the faster you hurt him, the sooner the big ones come. Breaks and Slow both land on him. lines: Pest control, done! Do we get a certificate?

dboxTimeline.text: Kilika Temple, the Chamber of the Fayth. The pyreflies are thick as flies on a summer pond.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Pest control, they said. Nobody said the pests would be glowing.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: These are not pests. They are somebody’s memories.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Something is feeding them.
Ifrit rises from the fayth, wrapped in pyreflies that are not his.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Ifrit... It is us. Please, listen.
The aeon turns. The fire in his eyes is not his own.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Okay, that is a very angry campfire.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Then we put it out.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Hmm! Right. Nobody burns this temple down today.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: He picked the one at the back! Why is it always the back?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Keep her healed.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: That was all of us at once!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Next time, shell up first.
The pyreflies lift from Ifrit like sparks from a dying fire.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Ifrit... are you all right?
The aeon bows his head once, and settles back into the fayth.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Someone is waking the fayth on purpose.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Then we find them.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Pest control, done! Do we get a certificate?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: No.
